written.title: Walmart GTA 6 Pre-Orders Will Include A ‘Surprise’ - Kotaku
written.description: What Rock Paper Shotgun, GamesRadar+, PC Gamer and Kotaku reported about Want on 29 October 2026, quoted in their own words with a link to each report.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Want, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## Rock Paper Shotgun, 29 October 2026

[GTA 6 has a smell reaction system, which immediately joins Red Dead Redemption 2's dynamically shrinking horse balls on Rockstar's list of immersive symbols of excess](https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/gta-6-has-a-smell-reaction-system-which-immediately-joins-red-dead-redemption-2s-dynamically-shrinking-horse-balls-on-rockstars-list-of-immersive-symbols-of-excess)

The outlet's own summary:

> GTA 6 has a smell reaction system which feels like it'll go down in history in a similar fashion to Red Dead Redemption 2's temperature sensitive horse balls.

> They reportedly did not leave it at that, later going back to flesh out this one smell reaction into a broader system which other locations to inspire various degrees of face-scrunching by protagonists Lucia and Jason.

> Cue, in the demo of the game in action which Rockstar gave Edge, Jason walking into a house and starting to act like someone who's just walked into a shower-averse teenager's bedroom during a heatwave despite that not having been set up as part of a deliberately crafted encounter.

## GamesRadar+, 30 October 2026

[GTA 6 map size is so big it rivals GTA 4, GTA 5, and Red Dead Redemption 2's combined - and Rockstar devs are still discovering places they've never seen](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-map-size-is-so-big-it-rivals-gta-4-gta-5-and-red-dead-redemption-2s-combined-and-rockstar-devs-are-still-discovering-places-theyve-never-seen/)

The outlet's own summary:

> "It's insane," fans say

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

> Rockstar tells Edge as much as part of its exclusive cover story , revealing that the total land mass - including both Vice City and its surrounding areas - is almost as big as the playable maps that GTA 4, 5, and Red Dead Redemption 2 boast... combined.

## PC Gamer, 30 October 2026

[GTA 6's souped-up Red Dead Redemption 2-style morality system will scale from 'Professional' to 'Irredeemable' so players can decide what kind of criminal they want to be](https://www.pcgamer.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6s-souped-up-red-dead-redemption-2-style-morality-system-will-scale-from-professional-to-irredeemable-so-players-can-decide-what-kind-of-criminal-they-want-to-be/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Not every act of violence needs to end in death.

> Latest Videos From PC Gamer Watch full video here: Fights don't need to always end in death, a professional criminal may incapacitate their opponent instead of putting a bullet between their eyes or perhaps try to get information or whatever they want from them via less violent means, at least at first.

> We've already learned a bit about the Criminal Profile before thanks to an IGN preview in which Nelson also explained how the decision to include such a responsive system stemmed from the fact that the devs didn't want player characters to become too powerful.

> (Image credit: Rockstar Games) The Criminal Profile will track your actions as Lucia and Jason on a scale from "Professional" to "Irredeemable", represented by angel and devil icons.

## GamesRadar+, 1 November 2026

[GTA 6 lets you break up Jason and Lucia if you want, and we can thank Red Dead Redemption 2's Arthur Morgan for the choice](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-lets-you-break-up-jason-and-lucia-if-you-want-and-we-can-thank-red-dead-redemption-2s-arthur-morgan-for-the-choice/)

The outlet's own summary:

> "But what if these characters want something else?"

> "But what if these characters want something else?" According to the developer, that question first popped up during the development of Red Dead Redemption 2.

> Rockstar Games ' huge open worlds almost always throw excessive amounts of in-game money at the player, but the studio's Western sequel made players think a little harder about where they want to spend that cash.

> While Grand Theft Auto 6 follows the two central characters of Jason and Lucia, the game never really forces their relationship in directions that aren't steered by the player.

> Jason and Lucia can become romantically tangled if you choose or they can remain partners in crime.

## Kotaku, 2 November 2026

[Walmart GTA 6 Pre-Orders Will Include A ‘Surprise’ - Kotaku](https://kotaku.com/grand-theft-auto-6-pre-order-walmart-surprise-release-date-2000752341)

The outlet's own summary:

> Give me a 10-inch statue of Jason, then we’ll talk

> For that much money, I’d better be getting a high-quality, sculpted statue of Jason and Lucia .

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
